title: Sughra (s.a) Salaam Aakhri Lelo Hussain (a.s) ka
body:
Rukhsat har ek bibi se jab ho chuke Hussain
Maqtal ke simt jaane lage shahe mashreqain
Dekha suey Madina to shabir ne kaha
Sughra, meri sughra, haye sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
Sughra salaam aakhri lelo Hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar ki laash sughra mei tanha utha chuka
Khat bhi tumhara laash pe uski sunna chuka
Noor e nazar jo tha mera duniya se jaa chuka
Dil usska haye noke sinna hi mei reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Sughra tumhara chaand sa bhai besheer khwaar
Wo jiske muskurane se tumko bohot tha pyaar
Wo muskuraya teer galle se huwa jo paar
Zibha wo meri gowd mei mera pisar huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas ke alam pe tarapti hain bibiyaa
Ab tak lahoo hain usske katte haath se rawaa
Dariya pe usski laash tarapti hain mei yahaa
Abbas mera sher sa bhai nahi raha
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekhi na tumne haye Sakina ki bebasi
Maqtal ke simt jab ke sawaari meri barhi
Aansoo bahaate saath sawaari ke wo challi
Hai Karbala se Shaam talak usski qatlgaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek shab ki biyahi bewaa tumhari behan huwi
Qasim ki laash ghatri mein mei ne uthaayi thi
Ghatri se khoon behta raha pusht pe meri
Tukro mei usski laash ke kangna tha khoon bhara
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab ghum mei dil pe le chuka laashe utha chuka
Lekin nahi hay dum mere sinne mei ba khudda
Barchi pe kaise dekhunga Zainab ki mei rida
Noke sinna pe royega kat ke bhi sar mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqtal mei aake bole samar shah e zi waqar
Eh meri laadli mei chala suey kirde gaar
Gar ho sake tho karna na ab mera intezaar
Ujra Madina saj gayi laasho se Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
Sughra salaam aakhri lelo Hussain ka
